integrity: The exact proof and executable checker are provided; executed finite tests corroborate but do not replace the all-parameter proof. No independent external audit.
scientific_limitations: Only Boolean ℓ_2 counting models of full Weyl orbits with N>=8 and flat-plus-two-site windows; no all-window optimum or nonlinear noise theorem; published one-site optimizer is credited; historical novelty subject to unindexed literature.
title: Two-defect Boolean Gabor tomography has a sharp eight-point conditioning rigidity
